verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented claim, benchmark, or hands-on report that Kong AI Gateway adds minimal latency overhead to provider calls. The latency items (docs-9, docs-35) describe observability metrics that measure latency, not low overhead. The architecture note that the control plane stays out of the data path (docs-50) is an adjacent design detail and does not show proxy overhead is small.
